modules.title: Modules
modules.description: Every module this deployment displays, each with the region it is laid out into. A region may carry several modules, and a region no entry names holds nothing.

region.title: Region
region.description: The region of the display this module is laid out into, from the fixed roster.

module.title: Module
module.description: The name of the module to render, as the page registers it.

options.title: Module options
options.description: What this placement asks of the module it names. The keys on offer are the named module's own, declared in that module's section below, and a module with no section there is not judged by another module's keys; two placements of the same module are configured apart, each from its own entry.

edge_band.title: Edge band
edge_band.description: Depth of the masked band every laid-out region keeps clear of, on all four edges, as a percentage of the display's height — the same unit the type and spacing scales are stated in. Omit it where the display presents its own edge; nothing is assumed in its absence.

clockOptions.title: Clock options
clockOptions.description: The clock module's section: what a placement of the clock may ask of it. Every key is omissible, and a clock configured with none of them takes the defaults below.

twenty_four_hour.title: Twenty-four-hour
twenty_four_hour.description: Whether the hour is presented in twenty-four-hour form. False presents it in twelve-hour form, carrying the indicator that tells the two halves of the day apart.

show_seconds.title: Show seconds
show_seconds.description: Whether the seconds of the current time are shown beside the rest of it.

show_date.title: Show date
show_date.description: Whether the current date is shown beside the time.
